[[Razorstone]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] dropped by [[Tanzit Razorstone]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Axe Mastery]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance: 10%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Sephis Axe]].
